Softmax turns scores into probabilities

roadmap.stepGoal: See why scores are exponentiated and normalised
roadmap.passageText: A model produces raw scores called logits. Softmax exponentiates each score and divides by the sum so the results are positive and add to one. A larger score gets a larger share.

items.prompt: What a decision tree split does

roadmap.stepTitle: What a decision tree split does
roadmap.stepGoal: See how one question divides the training rows
roadmap.passageText: A decision tree picks a question about one feature, such as is the age above 30. Rows that answer yes go to one branch and the rest to the other. The split is chosen to make each branch purer.

items.prompt: How a bakery plans its dough

roadmap.stepTitle: How a bakery plans its dough
roadmap.stepGoal: See how yesterday and the weekday set today's batch
roadmap.passageText: A small bakery keeps a log of loaves sold each day. On Fridays it sells more than on Mondays, so the manager scales the next day batch from the average of the same weekday, then adds a small margin.

items.prompt: Why compound interest grows faster

roadmap.stepGoal: See interest earning interest year by year
roadmap.passageText: A savings account adds interest each year to the balance. The next year interest is paid on the larger balance, so the growth each year gets bigger even though the rate stays the same.

items.prompt: What a convolution filter does

roadmap.stepGoal: See a small window sliding over an image
roadmap.passageText: A convolution layer slides a small grid of weights over the image. At each position it multiplies the weights with the pixels under it and sums them, producing one number of a new feature map.

items.prompt: How a thermostat holds a temperature

roadmap.stepTitle: How a thermostat holds a temperature
roadmap.stepGoal: See the loop of measuring and switching
roadmap.passageText: A thermostat measures the room temperature and compares it with the set point. If the room is colder it switches the heater on, if it is warmer it switches it off, and the cycle repeats.

items.prompt: How a spam filter learns

roadmap.stepGoal: See words and labels turned into a score
roadmap.passageText: A spam filter counts how often each word appears in spam and in normal mail. A new message gets a score from the words it contains, and a score above a threshold is marked as spam.

items.prompt: How vaccines teach the immune system

roadmap.stepTitle: How vaccines teach the immune system
roadmap.stepGoal: See exposure, memory and a faster second response
roadmap.passageText: A vaccine shows the immune system a harmless piece of a virus. The body makes antibodies and keeps memory cells, so a later infection triggers a faster and stronger response.

items.prompt: What overfitting looks like

roadmap.stepGoal: See training error fall while validation error rises
roadmap.passageText: As a model gets more flexible its training error keeps falling. Past some point the validation error starts to rise because the model memorises noise in the training rows.

items.prompt: How a bus stop is placed

roadmap.stepTitle: How a bus stop is placed
roadmap.stepGoal: See demand, distance and cost compared
roadmap.passageText: A city planner compares candidate stops by the number of riders within a five minute walk, the distance to the next stop, and the cost of building a shelter.

items.prompt: How a language model picks a next word

roadmap.stepTitle: How a language model picks a next word
roadmap.stepGoal: See probabilities over words and a sample
roadmap.passageText: A language model gives a probability to each possible next word. The temperature setting flattens or sharpens these probabilities before one word is sampled.

items.prompt: How the elbow method picks clusters

roadmap.stepTitle: How the elbow method picks clusters
roadmap.stepGoal: See the error fall as clusters are added
roadmap.passageText: K-means is run for several numbers of clusters. The total within-cluster distance falls as clusters are added, and the bend of the curve suggests a good number of clusters.
